messages.shadow: Declaration of '{{name}}' shadows the prop with the same name.

cases.code:
<script setup>
      const props = defineProps(['foo'])
      </script>

<script setup>
      const { foo } = defineProps({ foo: String })
      </script>

<script setup lang="ts">
      const { foo, bar } = defineProps<{ foo: string, bar: number }>()
      </script>

<script setup lang="ts">
      interface Props {
        foo: string
      }
      const { foo = 'default' } = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), { foo: 'default' })
      </script>

<script setup>
      import { ref } from 'vue'
      const props = defineProps(['foo'])
      const bar = ref(props.foo)
      </script>

<script setup>
      defineProps(['foo'])
      function bar() {
        const foo = 1
        return foo
      }
      </script>

<script setup>
      defineProps(['foo'])
      const bar = (foo) => foo
      </script>

<script setup>
      defineProps(['bar'])
      const foo = defineModel('foo')
      </script>

<script setup lang="ts">
      interface foo {
        bar: string
      }
      defineProps<{ foo: string }>()
      </script>

<script setup lang="ts">
      import type { foo } from './foo'
      import { type bar } from './bar'
      defineProps<{ foo: foo, bar: string }>()
      </script>

<script>
      const foo = 1
      export default {
        props: ['foo'],
        setup() {
          const foo = 2
          return { bar: foo }
        }
      }
      </script>

<script setup>
      const foo = 1
      </script>

<script setup>
      import { ref } from 'vue'
      defineProps(['foo'])
      const foo = ref(false)
      </script>
